Jonas — thanks for sending this over and for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement and our side: 

1) Procurement timing: Standard timeline is ~7–10 business days once final contract and SOW are with Procurement. For our internal calendar, we need the final contract on our desk by March 17 to hit a March 26 executed date (legal routing plus exec signature).

2) PO vs. signature: We do not require a PO before signature; Procurement issues the PO after signature in our workflow. However, we need the final billing contact and an invoice template during routing.

3) Security evidence: I will ask Tom (cc'd) to prioritize the SOC2 artifact request and share required fields for the data-flow statement. Tom, can you confirm what you need from Redwood?

4) Procurement lead: Please work with Tom (tom.willis@acmecorp.com). He’ll be leading the contract routing.

If you can move the MAP target for "finalize commercial terms" to Feb 18, that gives our legal team a bit more time for review. I can join a short sync on Wed if needed.

—Emily
Director, Cloud Engineering | Acme Corp
